title: Assistance with a human in control
lead: AI-assisted workflows can propose engineering steps, while review and application remain human responsibilities.
description: The described explorations use command-line and Model Context Protocol interfaces; they support partial assistance rather than autonomous chip design.

sections.title: A bounded workflow
paragraphs: An engineer can define a task, receive a proposed action, inspect its assumptions and run or apply an accepted step. Results still need conventional checks.

sections.title: Where information goes
paragraphs: Local solver execution and any information sent to an external assistant are different boundaries. Confidentiality properties depend on the actual configuration and require confirmation.

sections.title: What remains to prove
paragraphs: Repeatability, failure handling, auditability and value relative to a manual workflow need systematic evaluation before broader operational claims.
